title: lane finish reads a Ticket/Refs trailer that sits above the Co-Authored-By paragraph
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: `krn lane finish routing-fair-arms` refused "the HEAD commit of routing-fair-arms has no Ticket or Refs trailer" although c0270cb carries `Refs: t-188gftz`: the harness attribution puts `Co-Authored-By` in its own final paragraph, so git's trailer block (last paragraph only) holds no Refs; src/cli/lane-finish.ts:47-62 trailerOf reads only %(trailers).

Outcome: lane finish finds the task from a Ticket/Refs line in any trailer-only paragraph at the end of the message (git trailers first, then trailing `Key: value` paragraphs), so the standard commit shape `Refs: <id>\n\nCo-Authored-By: ...` ships.
Proof: test/cli/lane-finish.test.ts: a HEAD commit with `Refs: t-xxxxxxx` above a separate Co-Authored-By paragraph resolves task t-xxxxxxx with key Refs.
